register: # SOURCE: Wattsonic 'GEN3 Hybrid Inverter MODBUS RTU Protocol' register tables, as transcribed at smarthome.exposed (vendor PDF itself not retrievable). Cross-checked against TapHome Gen3 template which cites the vendor PDF.

# DEVICE FAMILY: a-TroniX AX hybrid inverters (AKKU SYS GmbH) are rebadged Wattsonic Gen3 units (also sold as M-TEC / Solinteg / Sunways / St-ems). Clone relationship is reported by TapHome + Homey + evcc; NOT yet confirmed by a hardware test of an AX unit.

# SERIAL: Modbus RTU via EMS port, 9600 8N1, slave id 247 (Gen3 default; some docs say 1). Modbus TCP: port 502 unit 255. All registers read with FC03 (holding). Addresses are 0-based protocol addresses.

# NOT COVERED: bit tables for fault flags / equipment info / working-mode / battery-config (vendor tables 3.x not transcribed); 53500-53523 'BMS data for EMS' block (written BY an EMS, not inverter telemetry); older a-TroniX Gen2 (WTS) units use a different 1xxxx-5xxxx map.
# WRITABLE: every row is R in this file by design. Vendor marks 20000, 25100, 25103, 5xxxx rows as read/write.
